issue: Incorrect password is accepted for sign-in
actual: Logged in as user 'qatester2026' (email different2026@example.com) using password 'wrongpassword' instead of the registered password 'password123'. The app redirected to home page with the user fully signed in (nav.profile shows username, logout action present) instead of rejecting the login.
evidence: Filled login.email=different2026@example.com, login.password=wrongpassword, clicked login.submit; resulting semantic_snapshot showed nav.profile='qatester2026' and nav.logout action present, URL='/'.

Registered username=qatester2026, email=different2026@example.com, password=password123 (>=6 chars); was signed in immediately (nav.profile showed username). Logged out (nav showed Login/Register) and signed back in with same credentials, restoring session. Attempting to register the same username with a different email was rejected with 'Username or email already exists'; attempting to register a different username with the same email was also rejected with the same message.

Edited profile: bio='QA engineer who loves testing forums and breaking things.', interests='Testing, Coding, Coffee'. After Save, profile.bio and profile.interests displayed the saved values (interests rendered as 'Testing Coding Coffee' tags) on the public profile page.

Submitting with all fields empty produced notification 'Please fill in all fields' and stayed on /new-thread. Submitting with title+body filled but no category selected was also rejected (remained on /new-thread with values retained, no thread created).

Published thread with category=Technology, title='QA Test Discussion: Automated Testing Tools', body text. Thread detail page displayed matching title, content, and author. Thread also appears under /category/tech listing (thread-1787705284463).

/category/tech showed only tech threads (thread-7, thread-1, thread-1787705284463). Switching to /category/gaming changed the result set to only gaming threads (thread-4 'Best indie games of 2023...'). Category filter correctly scopes results and updates on category change.

Posted reply 'This is a QA test reply to verify reply functionality.' on thread-1787705331754. Without any reload, the reply appeared in thread.replies collection and thread.reply-count updated from '0 replies' to '1 replies'.

Thread thread-1787705331754: after posting 2 replies, thread.reply-count displayed '2 replies' and thread.replies collection listed exactly 2 items (reply-1787705336647, reply-1787705345017), matching at each step (1 reply -> count 1; 2 replies -> count 2).

Thread upvote (thread-6, author NewsHound): 156 -> click -> 157 (button showed active state) -> click again -> 156. Reply upvote (reply-5 on thread-6, author TechExplorer): 45 -> click -> 46 -> click again -> 45. Both counts and toggle state update immediately without reload.

Clicked author link from a reply (TechExplorer) -> opened /profile/user-1 showing username 'TechExplorer', 'Joined about 3 years ago', '2,450 reputation', bio text, interest tags (Programming, Open Source, AI/ML, DevOps), and 'Threads by TechExplorer (2)' listing thread-1 and thread-7.

Search 'keyboard' returned only thread-7 ('Building a mechanical keyboard from scratch'). Search 'KEYBOARD' (uppercase) returned the same single result, confirming case-insensitivity. Search 'zzzznonexistentqueryxyz' returned empty list with message 'No threads found. Try adjusting your search terms.'

Most Active initial order (by reply count desc): 89,67,45,41,38,34,31,23. Added 9 replies to thread-1 (23->32 replies). Re-checking Most Active: order became 89,67,45,41,38,34,32,31 with thread-1 moving above thread-3 (31), confirming correct descending order and live re-ranking.

Initial Trending order (upvotes desc): 156,124,92,89,78,67,56,47. After 4 distinct users each cast one upvote on thread-2 (89->93), Trending list re-sorted to 156,124,93,92,78,67,56,47 with thread-2 moving above thread-7, confirming descending order and live re-ranking on voting.

issue: No stated recent time window for Trending/Most Active; ranking includes very old activity
actual: The 'Trending Discussions' and 'Most Active Discussions' headings/subtext ('Join the conversation with our community') contain no mention of any time window (e.g. 'This Week', 'Last 30 days'). Threads shown in both lists include ones timestamped 'over 2 years ago' (e.g. thread-6, thread-4, thread-7), proving the ranking is not scoped to any recent period at all, it just ranks by all-time upvote/reply counts.
evidence: browser_snapshot of Most Active view: heading 'Most Active Discussions', subtitle 'Join the conversation with our community', top items show time='over 2 years ago' for thread-6, thread-4, thread-7, thread-8, thread-5, thread-3, thread-1.

issue: Community/category stat counters do not update when new records are created
actual: stats.threads remained '1,045' after creating 2 new threads (one still live: thread-1787705579375 in Creative Corner). Creative Corner category count remained '(89)' despite the new thread being added to it. stats.members remained '892' after registering 6 new accounts (4 still live: qauser02-05). stats.replies remained '4,823' after adding 9 replies to thread-1 (which alone should add +9). None of the community stat counters reflected the new activity.
evidence: Before: stats.threads=1045, stats.members=892, stats.replies=4823, Creative Corner=(89). After creating thread-1787705579375 in Creative Corner and having 4 live extra registered accounts and +9 replies on thread-1: all values identical (stats.threads=1045, stats.members=892, stats.replies=4823, Creative Corner=(89)).

As qauser05 (same loaded session, no reload): set bio='FT-13 persistence test bio.', interests='Persistence, Sessions'; created thread CT-21 Counter Test Thread; upvoted it (count 1); posted a reply on thread-4. Logged out (reply and thread still visible to anon view) then logged back in with same credentials: profile bio/interests unchanged, authored thread still listed under 'Threads by qauser05 (1)', and the thread's upvote count remained 1 (vote state preserved).

issue: All application state is held only in memory and is lost on page reload
actual: After a page reload: the signed-in user (qauser05) was logged out (nav shows Login/Register instead of profile). The account's authored thread 'CT-21 Counter Test Thread' (thread-1787705579375) disappeared entirely from the threads list. Reply-count and upvote changes made during the session were reverted (thread-1 back to 23 replies from 32; thread-2 back to 89 upvotes from 93). Registered accounts, profile edits, authored discussions, replies, and vote state do not survive a reload.
evidence: localStorage and sessionStorage were empty ({}) and document.cookie was empty, confirming no persistence layer; a full reload (browser_navigate to '/') reset nav to Login/Register and restored all seed thread counters to their original values while newly created content vanished.

issue: Unauthenticated access to discussion creation results in a blank page instead of a usable sign-in screen
actual: Navigating to /new-thread while logged out renders a completely blank page (only an empty notifications region, no header, no nav, no form, no sign-in prompt). A console warning 'You should call navigate() in a React.useEffect(), not when your component is first rendered' indicates a broken redirect attempt to the login screen that fails to actually render, leaving the user stuck on a blank page with no way to sign in or return to thread creation.
evidence: browser_snapshot of /new-thread while unauthenticated: only '- generic [active]: - generic: - region \"Notifications alt+T\"'. Console warning about improper navigate() call present.
